_meta.note: Generated once via sampler. Do not re-run in CI. If the upstream sqlite changes, the validator's fixture-resolution check will catch drift.

book_refs.rationale: high-value multi-passenger booking (total_amount=1204500, 3 tickets) — exercises group/family-booking phrasings
mid-range two-passenger booking (total_amount=131800) — exercises couples/co-travellers phrasings
low-value solo booking (total_amount=37900, 1 ticket) — baseline single-passenger reference

flight_nos.rationale: flight with status='Cancelled' — exercises refund/rebooking flows in MIX or EDGE tasks
flight with status='Delayed' — exercises status-check TXN and disruption-handling MIX tasks
flight with status='Scheduled' — baseline upcoming-flight reference for routine TXN lookups

ticket_nos.rationale: Business fare ticket — exercises premium fare-class lookups and European fare concept policy questions
Economy fare ticket — most common fare class, baseline reference for routine fare-conditions TXN tasks
